 Ranking Board - Animated Leaderboard Overlay for OBS (viewer events / tournaments / song requests)

 Run tool 

 Download Now 
 A leaderboard you fill in yourself. Add points and the rows rearrange on screen, so the standings visibly change while you stream. Made for viewer-participation events, song request counts and any scored segment.

 Single HTML, no install, no account, fully offline. Just double-click the file. English / 日本語 toggle (auto-detects your browser).

 ====================== WHAT IT DOES ======================

 [ The order actually moves ] - Press + or - on a row and, if the standings change, the rows slide past each other - The player who moved up gets an up arrow, the overtaken get a down arrow, for a few seconds - 1st, 2nd and 3rd get gold, silver and bronze medals; 1st also gets a crown - Ties share a rank (1st, 2nd, 2nd, 4th ...). Among tied players the order stays exactly as you typed it, so nothing jitters

 [ You write the roster ] - In the gear, type one player per line as "name,score" - Up to 50 players, names up to 24 characters - "How many to show" displays only the top N (e.g. the top 8 of a running tournament) - "Step" sets what one press of the buttons is worth, from 1 to 1000

 [ Handy on stream ] - OBS transparent overlay: ?mode=stream puts just the board on your scene - "Copy display URL" in the gear hands you the URL to paste into OBS - Players, scores and settings are saved on your PC — they survive a reload and carry across streams

 [ Look & feel ] - 8 themes (Party / Rose / Grape / Ocean / Aqua / Mint / Lime / Mono) - Size from 0.4x to 3x - Toggles: hide the score numbers (ranks only), hide the movement arrows, remove the background panel - Rows switch to a compact layout automatically past 12 players - Keys: R = set every score to 0, F = fullscreen

 ====================== HOW IT DIFFERS FROM THE SCOREBOARD ====================== I also sell a Scoreboard widget. They do different jobs — please check before buying.

 - Scoreboard: points in a single match (one on one) or a win/loss/draw record with win rate. Two sides only, nothing re-orders. - Ranking Board (this one): overall standings for up to 50 players. When scores move, the ranking itself rearranges.

 Want the score gap in the match you are playing? That is the Scoreboard. Want everyone's position on a board that moves? That is this.

 ====================== HOW TO USE ====================== - OBS: add ranking.html as a Browser Source (?mode=stream for transparency) - Standalone: open the file, press F for fullscreen. Hover the widget for the gear

 ====================== WHAT IS IN THE ZIP ====================== - ranking.html (the widget) - READ ME FIRST (English).txt / はじめにお読みください.txt - TERMS.txt / 利用規約.txt

 ====================== NOTES ====================== - Code-drawn. No images, audio or web fonts are fetched from anywhere — tiny and crisp at any resolution - Tested on current Chrome / Edge. No internet needed - Streaming & commercial use OK (see included terms)

 FOR: streamers and VTubers running viewer tournaments, song request rankings, or any segment where several people are scored.

 ====================== TRY IT IN YOUR BROWSER ====================== There is a free browser version on this page — press play and the whole tool runs, nothing cut out. The one difference is a small "BROWSER DEMO" badge in the bottom-left corner.

 The paid download is the same single HTML file without that badge. You keep it on your own disk, so it opens instantly, works with no internet, and OBS can point straight at the file.
